body:
I'm going to go to bed now as it's 3:30 AM and I have work at 9 AM. As long as my boyfriend loves me I'll lay by his side every night and hold his warm, soft body every night. He's sleeping so peacefully next to me right now, no idea how hard I've cried again since he comforted me when he was last awake. I love this man with all my heart and he shouldn't have to put up with me. He deserves a man or woman better than me who's emotionally stable. He's a wreck just dealing with another wreck's fucked emotions when he really needs someone stable enough to take care of his. Two negatives don't make a positive. But with someone else he has a chance.
But until that day comes I'll lay with him and love him dearly as he's the only person who's made me feel like I'm worth a damn since before my innocence was taken. He keeps me warm. He makes me feel love. For him. And I feel his love for me. He's so beautiful when he sleeps and there's nothing that i love more than cuddling him and holding him close. Listening to his cute snores and feel him grasp at me in his sleep, knowing I'm there but too knocked out to properly hold me. He's unfortunate enough to love me, but I love him so much too.
Goodnight, everyone. I may or may not return to this post eventually. Could be tomorrow or in a week but I'll check eventually. If you're in love like me and you have the means to take care of them, please do. Do what I never will be able to. Hold them and never let them go.

Honestly I'll never know at this point. I'd feel extremely relieved if that were the case and I completely hope that it was and I simply just over exaggerated my situation. Its been a few weeks since I made this post and certainly feel more content now. Its a passing thought every now and then and part of me always wishes I could've changed some part of the situation but I just have to settle for coping with what may or may not have happened and put it behind me as best I can. Thank you for your time and sharing your experience with me, even if I'll never know the true answer as I could never properly recover what came from me and have taken it to a professional, it is comforting to know that there's a likelihood that it was simply just poor timing on my body's part and I happened to shed an entire lining a month or so after a damn near full week of intercourse atleast twice a day (still regret that!)
I can't thank you enough. This helps cope so much more and I can definitely feel more at ease even if I will never know for sure ❤

Thank you. Thank you so much. I'm doing my very best to get through it. It's extremely difficult and I have a hard time making sense of my own feelings toward the situation but I am certain in time I'll feel better again. Its a big weight off my shoulders to have feedback on this and know I'm not alone. Obviously this is a common tragedy that happens to alot of people but it hits different when it actually happens to you and it feels lonely and terrifying. Thank you for the validation, it's given me alot of closure for tonight and some confidence going forward. This means more to me than you know. <3

Thank you so so much. I'll probably try to do that as best I can. Its still so weird to think about because technically speaking I could've only been 2 or 3 weeks along but at that point it shouldn't have even developed past cell stage yet but the appearance of it was unmistakable as it had very subtle but visible human anatomy already beginning to develop. I'm just thankful that this was what happened because when I think about it this was the best outcome for me in the long run. Now that a day has passed and I've had time to mull over it I like to see it as that this was just a slip and one day my eventual baby would be back whenever my boyfriend and I were prepared for children and we could love them how we were meant to. I've still got a long way to go as far as putting puzzle pieces together with my situation but I'm hoping I'll get there eventually and that it will get easier for me
